what: our carbon_intensity vs EIA 'CO2 Emissions Generated' / Adjusted net generation, PJM
likely_reason_for_bias: EIA uses PJM-fleet emission factors (same file, columns 'CO2 Factor: COL/NG': about 2.21 and 0.86 lb CO2/kWh in 2024-2026); we use 2023 national averages (2.31 and 0.96). Our gas factor is ~11% higher and gas is ~40% of PJM generation.
